known_job_timing.scope: Actual process creation through terminal RESULT receipt write; this is not a fresh global CPU quiet-process audit and excludes post-receipt teardown

limitations: Single seed and repeated post-T developmental V; no independent generalization or convergence claim.
R5a keeps the exact R4 P/E/D but adds a fixed three-epoch A60 head fit; A_stop is not an unseen head-selection set and total training information/budget is not identical to pretrained Bolt.
R5b searches three epochs and selects one before fresh A60 refit; same P/E/D architecture does not mean identical learned representation or parameter budget.
Recorded R4 scores are lower than both no-Bolt scores, but this only supports a local advantage over these standard linear alternatives; G/ridge/LoRA and other data remain separate comparisons.
R4/no-Bolt time ratios compare compatible recorded CPU whole-pipeline measurements taken at different times; they are not a universal speedup claim or simultaneous paired timing experiment.
Stage-probe timing is intrusive and separate from timed whole-pipeline trials; stage medians are not claimed to sum to whole median.
active_adapter_MiB is GPU-specific and zero here; CPU resident weights and process RSS are nonzero and distinct quantities.
The original fit RESULT pending flags and ROOT_seal pre-execution flags are historical snapshots; later separate rescore and replay PASS receipts establish the reviewed current completion.
This review reaggregates saved sufficient statistics and trial measurements; it does not rerun prediction-array auditing, checkpoint inference, training or costs.
publication_state: Local new review receipt only; this receipt does not establish commit/push/remote verification
